name: Dashboard
author: Kirin
short: Unicornia's staff and member web sites, behind Discord login
description: Serves staff.unicornia.net (ban records, AutoMod, read-only Unicornia and modmail history, for staff with 2FA) and my.unicornia.net (profile, backgrounds, stocks, club, waifu, leaderboard and warnings for every member, roleplay and bot settings, roleplay gifs to browse and vote on, and a staff application for Level 30+ members; custom commands, emojis and role for supporters) from inside the bot.
install_msg: Thanks for installing the Dashboard. Follow the README deployment checklist before loading it.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data about users. Staff logins read the Discord account's ID and 2FA status once, and member logins read only the account's ID; the resulting session is held in memory only and ends after 12 hours, on logout, or when the cog unloads. The staff site shows modmail conversations read-only from the modmail bot's database, with attachment links re-signed through Discord when viewed and held in memory until they expire; no copy is kept. Changes made on the member site are stored by the cog that owns them (CustomCommand, CustomEmoji, CustomRoleColor, Responder, Roleplay, UnicornAI, Unicornia). The member site also shows members, read-only, their own Unicornia stocks, club and waifu standing and their own warnings (without the moderator), read from those cogs when the page is opened. A gif a member sends in is held in a temporary file only while the Roleplay cog posts it to its staff review channel. A staff application is posted to a staff channel with the member's mention, user ID, level role, join date and answers, and is not stored by the cog; the time of a member's last application is held in memory only, until the bot restarts, to allow one a week.
